text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer got injured, so I take her to the infirmary just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You really don't have to freak out so much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, I'm good. I appreciate the worry, but I can get back to training, no biggie.
choice_data_list: There's no such thing as being too careful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Okay, how 'bout we compromise with a sports wrap? That should be more than enough.
choice_data_list: I still think you should rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Okay, how 'bout we compromise with a sports wrap? That should be more than enough.
choice_data_list: I still think you should rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fine. I guess you have a point… Welp, guess I'll head back and rest, then. Laters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can't believe I messed up so bad…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A disappointed Mejiro Palmer returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's the spirit! Now, to the track!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There, I'm all warmed up again. I won't push myself, promise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That hurts… Man, I guess it was a biggie after all…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My bad. Sorry for stressing you out even more…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer can't continue training after all and goes back to her dorm with her shoulders slumped.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer runs so freely that I can't even tell she's hurt!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… See? Told ya it was nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Luckily, her injury turns out to be very minor. She paces herself well and completes the rest of today's session without further incident.
